mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5pp does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% year-over-year, it signals a tightening monetary policy with a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with slowing economy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS > 4% and GDPC1 YoY growth < 2% does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decline > 1% does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past month signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the past month signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 200k does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing at an annualized rate of more than 3% over the past two months, it signals accommodative monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 3% does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.
